characters.prophet: DJ Gifted Prophet — a young man with LIGHT olive skin (lighter than before), Ray-Ban nerdy glasses, a goatee, wearing a black baseball cap with white letters 'LL' on the front. Male vocalist.
characters.femcee: The female vocalist — a young Black woman with bold curly hair, gold hoop earrings, wearing an oversized vintage graphic tee, West Coast femcee style. First consistent second member of the group.

concept: Derived purely from the lyrics. 'Chain on the Canvas' = the on-chain ledger is painted/carved onto a city canvas/mural: spray paint, code, names in the ledger, 'carving code', 'paint fades off'. West Coast neon-decay palette, 90s MTV grain. Female vocalist OPENS the song (long 0-32s intro), DJ Gifted Prophet carries the body, female reprise near the end; this plants a consistent two-person group. SMALL % slow-mo (scenes 1 and 10). No on-screen text.
